objective: Implement local extraction JSON validation and the meeting review state machine so AI output is validated before mutation and meeting transitions are explicitly enforced.
success_criteria: Extraction JSON is validated against the local contract before any meeting-derived record mutation.
Invalid or incomplete extraction payloads fail safely and preserve the meeting for manual or retried review.
Meeting state transitions are enforced against the review-state document instead of being set ad hoc.
The implementation remains local-only and preserves the review gate between extraction output and final tasks.
stop_conditions: The task requires live provider execution or UI screen work.
The task requires changing canonical docs instead of implementing against them.
The task would bypass the meeting review gate or auto-finalize extracted tasks.
approval_gates: Introducing automatic final-task promotion from extraction output
Expanding scope into meeting review screens instead of validation and state logic
deliverables: Services or guards that enforce allowed meeting-state transitions
notes: Continue from T1-T12 already implemented in this repo.
Keep no-wait autonomous flow unless a real scope or approval boundary appears.
